999008199.text: ただいま～……って、随分埃っぽいわね

localizations.en: We're home... Wow, it's really dusty in here.

999008199.text:
ここしばらく一家全員、家を空けてたからな……
なんで家ってのは人がいないとボロくなるんだ？

localizations.en: Well, the whole family's been away for a while now... Why do houses always fall apart when nobody's around?

999008199.text:
はいはい、愚痴らないで
まずは掃除からしましょ～

localizations.en: Yeah, yeah, quit your griping. Let's start with some cleaning.

999008199.text: 桶にお水、汲んできますね！

天使ちゃんに力仕事はさせらんねぇ。
俺が汲んでくらぁ！

localizations.en: Can't let my angel do the heavy lifting. I'll get it!

999008199.text:
いやあ、勝手知ったる我が家は
やっぱり落ち着きますなぁ

localizations.en: Ahh, there's nothing quite like being back in your own home.

999008199.text:
私には、実家の屋敷よりも
こっちのほうが性に合ってるよ

localizations.en: This place suits me better than my family's estate ever did.

999008199.text: 第二の故郷ってことですね

localizations.en: So it's like a second home for you?

999008199.text: そそ。教会もあるから第三の故郷かもだけど

localizations.en: Exactly. Though with the church, maybe it's my third home.

999008199.text:
まったく、野良猫どもが住みついちまって
ありがた迷惑だ。な、天使ちゃん？

localizations.en: Honestly, all these stray cats moving in... What a pain. Right, angel?

999008199.text: ふふふ、それじゃあフロッケも野良猫ですね？

localizations.en: Hehe, does that make me a stray cat too?

999008199.text:
フロッケは家族だろうが。たとえ猫でも、
猫天使ちゃんだって！

localizations.en: You're family! Even if you were a cat, you'd be an angel cat!

999008199.text: あはは、なにそれ、猫天使って

localizations.en: Hahaha, what's that supposed to mean? An angel cat?

999008199.text: じゃあ私は猫悪魔だにゃん！

localizations.en: Then I guess I'm a devil cat, meow!

999008199.text: ……アルビーナ、今どうしてるかな

localizations.en: ...I wonder what Alvina's doing right now.

999008199.text: 今頃はあの子も家に戻ってる頃じゃない？

localizations.en: She's probably back home by now too, don't you think?

999008199.text: 少しは元気出たかしら……

localizations.en: I hope she's feeling a bit better...

999008199.text: どうかな。結構根深い問題な気はするからなあ……

localizations.en: That's hard to say. It did seem like a pretty deep-rooted issue...

999008199.text:
でもあの子だって、できることならあんたや、
レスナたちと一緒にいたいと思ってるはずだよ

localizations.en: But if she manages to overcome it, I'm sure she'd want to be with you and Resna.

999008199.text:
だから、アルビーナを信じて
気長に待つしかないんじゃない？

localizations.en: So we just have to trust in Alvina and wait.

999008199.text: そうね……

ベップさんやヤンネさんもついてますから、
きっと大丈夫ですよ

localizations.en: She has Bepp and Janne with her, so I'm sure she'll be okay.

999008199.text:
カロリンもあっちに残ってくれてるしね。
悩める子羊を導くのはお手のものだ

localizations.en: And Caroline stayed behind too. She's great at guiding lost lambs.

999008199.text: シスターさんですもんね

きっと、ちゃんと折り合いをつけて
立ち直ってくれるさ

localizations.en: Anyway, I'm sure she'll come to terms with things and bounce back.

999008199.text:
ただ、これからも一緒に冒険できるかは……
あの子次第だろうけどね

localizations.en: Though whether she'll keep adventuring with us... that'd be up to her.

999008199.text:
戻ってきてほしいわね……
せっかくここまで一緒にやってきたから

localizations.en: I hope she returns... We've come so far together.

999008199.text:
それは私も同じ気持ち。
ま、私はまだ会って間もないけどさ

localizations.en: Though I haven't known her that long, I feel the same.

999008199.text:
いざという時、
ああいう風に考えられる子が一緒だと心強いよ

localizations.en: When things get rough, it's reassuring to have someone who can think like that around.

999008199.text: ああいう風って、どういう風？

何かヤバいことに直面したら、
冷静に逃げる判断ができるってこと

localizations.en: Someone who can stay calm and make the call to retreat when something dangerous comes up.

999008199.text:
前々から思ってたけど、無茶しすぎなんだよ。
あんたも、レスナも

localizations.en: I've been thinking this for a while, but you two push yourselves way too hard. Both you and Resna.

999008199.text:
レスナは目的のためなら一直線だし、
あんたは自分が犠牲になっても構わないってタチだし

localizations.en: Resna charges straight ahead for her goals, and you're the type who doesn't mind sacrificing yourself.

999008199.text: ……それって、私が記憶を失くした時のことよね？

localizations.en: ...You're talking about the time I lost my memory, right?

999008199.text: その前にも何度も！　ホント、今生きてるのが奇跡だよ

localizations.en: And plenty of times before that too! Honestly, it's a miracle you're still alive.

999008199.text:
聞く限り、ほとんど不死身よね、私。
気を付けるわ

localizations.en: From what I've heard, I'm basically indestructible. But I'll be more careful.

999008199.text:
そりゃ、絶対できるって気持ちでやるのは大事だけど、
無理なもんは無理だって受け入れることも必要だよ

localizations.en: Sure, it's important to go in with confidence, but you also need to accept when something's just not possible.

999008199.text:
１回足を止めて、他に道がないか探してみる。
アルビーナはそういう判断ができる子だと思う

localizations.en: Take a step back and look for another way forward. I think Alvina's the kind of person who can make that sort of call.

999008199.text: きっと、これからの旅に必要な存在だ

localizations.en: She'll be essential for the journey ahead, I'm sure of it.
